'''2000 British Columbia Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in British Columbia, Canada in spring 2000. [[Alan Sagan]] won it and posted both of his decks.<ref name="dt-5329">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5329 Rops  Sagan Style], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 11 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5329/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5329/ GitHub Pages].</ref><ref name="dt-5325">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/5325 Throne Room  Sagan Style], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 11 April 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/5325/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/5325/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 8 April 2000<ref name="tr-d500" />
* '''Site:''' British Columbia, Canada; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada<ref name="tr-d500" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Alan Sagan]]
* '''Players:''' 33<ref name="tr-d500" />
